title: Lab - Validating and mutating admission webhooks
description: Register a webhook and see requests rejected and rewritten.
scenario: Register a webhook and see requests rejected and rewritten. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Deploy the webhook
tasks.instructions: Deploy the provided webhook server and its Service in namespace webhook-demo.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Register it
tasks.instructions: Create a MutatingWebhookConfiguration pointing at the Service with the CA bundle.

tasks.title: Task 3 - See it act
tasks.instructions: Create a Pod without a securityContext and read back what the webhook added.
tasks.solution:
kubectl run demo --image=nginx
kubectl get pod demo -o jsonpath='{.spec.securityContext}'
